scripts.suite:pipeline: : "${SUITE:?set SUITE=qa or SUITE=uat, or use npm run qa:pipeline / uat:pipeline}"; playwright test --grep "@$SUITE"; node .github/scripts/build-dashboard.mjs && node .github/scripts/preserve-prod-archive.mjs
scripts.pipeline: npm run qa:pipeline; npm run uat:pipeline
scripts.dashboard: npm run pipeline && echo "→ http://localhost:8899/" && cd site && python3 -m http.server 8899
scripts.qa:dashboard: npm run qa:pipeline && echo "→ http://localhost:8899/qa/" && cd site && python3 -m http.server 8899
scripts.uat:dashboard: npm run uat:pipeline && echo "→ http://localhost:8899/uat/" && cd site && python3 -m http.server 8899
